description: This file contains styling definitions for Bootstrap-like tables, including various table styles such as striped, bordered, hover, active states, and responsive behavior. It extensively uses SCSS variables, mixins, and nested rules targeting table elements for consistent styling across different table variants.
external_files: variables or mixins that define $prefix, $table-color, $table-bg, $table-border-color, $table-accent-bg, $table-striped-color, $table-striped-bg, $table-active-color, $table-active-bg, $table-hover-color, $table-hover-bg, $spacer, $table-cell-vertical-align, $table-cell-padding-y, $table-cell-padding-x, $table-border-width, $table-group-separator-color, $table-variants, $grid-breakpoints, and functions like breakpoint-infix, media-breakpoint-down.
